usage: agentware review-report [-h] [--format {text,json}]
                               [--state-dir STATE_DIR]
                               [--feature-dir FEATURE_DIR] [--worklog WORKLOG]
                               [--feature FEATURE] [--outcome OUTCOME]
                               [--no-workorders]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --state-dir STATE_DIR
                        dir holding the per-round adversarial-review-
                        round-N.json / adversarial-remediate-round-N.json
                        artifacts the loop wrote
  --feature-dir FEATURE_DIR
                        feature work dir the adversarial-review.md report is
                        written into
  --worklog WORKLOG     feature worklog.md the self-closing call-out markers
                        append to
  --feature FEATURE     feature name for the report header
  --outcome OUTCOME     final gate outcome for the report header (e.g. clean /
                        blocked)
  --no-workorders       do not emit follow-up workorders for low findings
